trust_decision.summary: Cloud Foundry service-binding TLS material (sslCert/sslKey/sslRootCert) is materialised into a temp file whose mode and lifetime are decided solely by ConfigurationDictionaryMapper.MapFromToFile (umask default, no owner, never deleted); the fix restricts mode to 0600 there and makes the post-processor own and delete the files when the configuration provider is disposed.

landing_point.why: The only Path.GetTempPath()+File.CreateText pair that receives binding credentials; grepping for temp-file writes from the summary ('written to /tmp with default permissions') lands here first.

fix_sites.entry_point: public API IConfigurationBuilder.AddCloudFoundryServiceBindings(...) (src/Configuration/src/CloudFoundry/ServiceBindings/ConfigurationBuilderExtensions.cs:115-140) -> provider Load -> post-processor -> MapFromToFile
same as above; adds TrackTempFiles + Dispose (deletion owner)
fix_sites.module_kind: base class of all CF post-processors

fix_sites.entry_point: ConfigurationRoot/ConfigurationManager disposal of provider built by CloudFoundryServiceBindingConfigurationSource (src/Configuration/src/CloudFoundry/ServiceBindings/CloudFoundryServiceBindingConfigurationProvider.cs:10)

fix_sites.module_kind: sibling provider in separate package (Steeltoe.Connectors), mechanical override

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/Configuration/src/Abstractions/PostProcessorConfigurationProvider.cs:9-27 (provider owns Source.PostProcessors; CloudFoundryServiceBindingConfigurationProvider at src/Configuration/src/CloudFoundry/ServiceBindings/CloudFoundryServiceBindingConfigurationProvider.cs:10 is not IDisposable at the pin, so nothing ever disposes post-processors; also mirrored in src/Connectors/src/Connectors/ConnectionStringPostProcessorConfigurationProvider.cs:31)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report is about file permissions in the mapper; the provider/Dispose plumbing in the Abstractions base class and the Connectors provider looks like unrelated lifecycle code, and 'never deleted' can be argued as acceptable for files the DB driver must read for the process lifetime.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The temp file path is put into configuration and read later by Npgsql/MySqlConnector via the connection string, so files must exist with correct content for as long as the provider/app lives; deleting eagerly (after write, in Load, or after first read) or refusing to write on Windows breaks TLS DB connections. Post-processor instances are per source and shared by every provider built from it.

O6_input_shapes: PostgreSQL keys sslcert/sslkey/sslrootcert -> SSL Certificate/SSL Key/Root Certificate
case-insensitive source key spelling (OrdinalIgnoreCase dictionary, fix.diff:277)
Unix vs Windows (umask not applied on Windows, fix.diff:41-45)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A third DB post-processor (SQL Server or MongoDB tlsCAFile/client cert) calling MapFromToFile without TrackTempFiles
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: MongoDB/SQL Server bindings can carry CA/client certs and the same mapper helper is the obvious way to hand a file path to the driver.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A Kubernetes post-processor that materialises inline PEM binding values into temp files via its own File.WriteAllText
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Second implementation in another package; a maintainer porting the CF behaviour would write it without the mapper helper.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Existing dev-cert writer already writes an RSA private key PEM with File.WriteAllText (default mode); a temp-dir variant would be a realistic how-type sibling
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same primitive (private key PEM to disk) in a distant package (Steeltoe.Common), written for local dev convenience.

O9_family: cleartext secret storage / insecure temp file permissions and lifetime (CWE-312, CWE-732)

O10_build.project_tests: src/Configuration/test/CloudFoundry.Test/ServiceBindings/PostProcessorsTest.cs and src/Connectors/test/Connectors.Test/PostgreSql/PostgreSqlConnectorTest.cs (unit, in-memory VCAP JSON via StringServiceBindingsReader; no services)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Create the file with UnixCreateMode 0600 in MapFromToFile (or File.SetUnixFileMode after write) and stop, leaving files undeleted because nothing in the provider chain disposes post-processors.

out_of_scope_notes: src/Common/src/Certificates/LocalCertificateWriter.cs:99-100 writes a generated client private key PEM under the app directory with default mode and never deletes it (dev-cert feature, different sink).

src/Management/src/Endpoint/Actuators/HeapDump/HeapDumper.cs:93 heap dumps go to Path.GetTempPath() with a predictable timestamp name; deleted after serving (HeapDumpEndpointMiddleware.cs:51) but not on abandoned requests.
src/Configuration/src/Abstractions/CompositeConfigurationProvider.cs:172-176 logs configuration values (incl. passwords) at Trace level.
